title: Same helper, three times
prompt: The robot's clock ticks. Write `tick`, which prints "tick", and call it three times from `solve`.
hints: Writing the print once in a function means solve only repeats the short call, not the print.
`func tick():` with `print("tick")`, then `tick()` three times in solve.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
